target_customer: Government agencies fulfilling public records requests (YC description); the current website instead serves people requesting records from government offices
problem: Agencies struggle to fulfill public records requests. The current site instead files and chases requests with 178,000+ state and local offices on behalf of requesters.

founders.name: Sam Crombie
prior_employers: Microsoft AI (Product Manager, including Edge Copilot and PowerBI Copilot teams)
education: Dartmouth College, A.B. in Computer Science, 2023
previous_startups: Actionbase (web automation SDK, outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: YC page says co-founder Adam McQuilkin on Actionbase. Whether Actionbase preceded Bluedoor is not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating request filing and tracking is workflow software plus LLM document handling, though coverage of thousands of agency portals takes grind.

defensibility.rationale: Agency workflow adoption creates some stickiness but several records platforms already exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitor search found no dated 2024 launches, only 2026 launches by Reveal, Everlaw and Casepoint into public records.

market_need_then: Public records volumes and redaction burdens on agencies are a known pain, but no dated evidence from 2024 was gathered.

branding.domain_note: Uses bluedoor.sh, not a .com. Other firms use the name Bluedoor.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct: file it, chase it, send you what comes back.

branding.community_and_virality: Public request log on the site shows recent requests such as Flock Safety contracts.

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated companies share the name and the branding search found no coverage of this one.

pivots.from: AI for public records request fulfillment for government agencies (YC)
pivots.to: Service that files public records requests to government offices for requesters (current site)
pivots.why: Not stated. Other directories also describe a CLI for stock research and data for AI, so the direction is unclear.

outcome_analysis: Bluedoor is an active solo-founder YC S24 company in GovTech. Directory descriptions disagree on what it does, and its website now shows a request-filing service, which points to a pivot or repositioning that no source explains. No funding, exit or distress news was found, so no success or failure factors are assigned.
notes: YC page says founded 2026 while other YC pages say 2024, so founded_year is null. No funding information in any search. Competitor list empty because results were 2026 launches or undated incumbents, not near the batch. Another YC page names a bluedoor CLI for stock research with the same founder, unconfirmed whether the same company.
